propositions: When a completion verifier run has banked an operator-actionable BLOCK (met=False and evidence_sufficient not False) and then encounters a provider outage, it should degrade to a deterministic FAIL verdict from the bank instead of dying verdict-less, with no further LLM calls
An empty criterion bank or a bank containing only PASSes/insufficiency placeholders should preserve the retryable exit-11 posture on provider outage, per ADR 0040
A degraded BLOCK verdict must be certifiable=False and must not auto-close the ticket; it flows to close_precheck's non-close branch to surface findings and require operator decision
The degrade path is guarded so any fault (bank read error, unreadable ticket) falls through to re-raise the outage unchanged, ensuring the degrade mechanism never introduces new failure modes
Certified PASS remains unreachable without full execution completion; a degrade verdict is always FAIL and certifiable=False so it can never sign or auto-close
